lines.2: Suddenly, I heard laughter coming from inside.
lines.4: I clapped a hand over Konoe's mouth.
lines.5: 「...I heard something interesting in there. Something about the school gate.」
lines.6: I whispered that to Konoe and pressed my ear to the wall.
lines.7: I could hear the conversation inside the classroom.
lines.8: 「President Konoe didn't bring up the gate today either, did sheee?」
lines.9: 「Looks like she's determined to handle it all by herself.」
lines.10: 「But my elite father says one-man rule leads to ruin.」
lines.12: 「Right. I'm sure even President Konoe would never imagine the people dirtying that gate were her own club members. My elite father always says to beware the enemy within...」
lines.14: The people deliberately dirtying the gate were members of the drama club!
lines.16: Apparently Konoe could hear them too.
lines.17: 「(They're confessing all on their own. Keep it together and wait!)」
lines.18: I whispered as quietly as I could.
lines.19: 「I feel kinda bad for the president, but we don't have much choiceee.」
lines.20: 「There's nothing to feel bad about. Justice is on our side.」
lines.21: 「Tuesday... gate still dirty... President Konoe, responsibility... resign.」
lines.22: 「Exactly. She said outright she'd quit as president if she couldn't finish the job.」
lines.23: 「This is our big chance to get her to step down!」
lines.29: I didn't even have time to stop her.
lines.30: Konoe threw the classroom door open in a fury.
lines.31: ...Yeah. I could smell a bloodbath coming.
lines.32: I followed her into the room.
lines.34: 「I heard everything! What the hell were you thinking!?」
lines.37: 「Of course I'm angry! Why would you stoop to something this underhanded!? Explain yourselves!!」
lines.38: 「...Heh... hehe... Well, if we're caught, there's no point hiding it. My elite father says to come clean when the truth comes out.」
lines.39: 「You said you wanted me removed as president. What exactly is that supposed to mean!?」
lines.40: 「Exactly what it sounds like, President Konoe. Frankly, having you as president is making things harder for us.」
lines.41: 「Huh!? How!? Our results improved, our budget went up! What more could you want!?」
lines.42: 「...I only just joined, but even I think it was amazing that we competed in the prefectural tournament this spring and did so well.」
lines.44: 「But isn't having fun supposed to be this drama club's motto!?」
lines.45: 「Yes. That's been the club's principle for generations.」
lines.46: 「But this drama club isn't fun anymore. To put it another way, I think it stopped being fun because of the way its leader is running it.」
lines.47: 「The strict practices eat up more and more of our time.」
lines.48: 「Quit whining! So what, practice is hard and you're already giving up?」
lines.49: 「You haven't even been in the club six months and you're talking awfully big...」
lines.50: 「It's not just the first-years. The second- and third-year senpai say the same thing.」
lines.52: 「The way you keep charging aheeead is making things hard for everyone.」
lines.53: 「The second-years say that too...? Hmph. Don't lie when it'll be so easy to check!」
lines.54: 「Everyone will be back soon. I think you'll understand once they are.」
lines.55: 「...Fine. Then we need to talk this through properly.」
lines.56: Ahh, this was getting messier by the second.
lines.57: Right now, Konoe was a bare blade. Touch her and she'd cut you.
lines.58: I decided not to provoke her any further.
lines.59: While we waited, the other club members started returning.
lines.60: Everyone seemed to sense that something was seriously wrong.
lines.61: Once the whole club was assembled, Konoe explained what had happened.
lines.63: 「What do the rest of you think?」
lines.65: 「Do you think I'm charging ahead on my own too!?」
lines.66: 「Dirtying the gate behind your back is completely indefensible... but as for how you've been running the club, I understand what the first-years mean.」
lines.68: 「Getting such a good result at the spring tournament was impressive, but you've increased practice way too much since then.」
lines.69: 「But we can aim even higher! If we can, working even harder is the logical thing to do, isn't it?」
lines.70: 「I understand that... but too much is still too much. It's causing problems.」
lines.71: 「Problems? You all love theater, don't you?」
lines.72: 「I love theater, but I love it because we all do it together and have fun, like.」
lines.73: 「Right now it kinda just hurts, like...」
lines.74: 「Of course it's hard, but there's glory waiting on the other side--」
lines.75: 「We love theater, but we're not going to devote our entire lives to it.」
lines.78: 「If that's how you felt, you should've talked to me...」
lines.79: 「We tried. You just said things like 'We'll work hard!' and 'Let's keep fighting!' without listening to what we were saying.」
lines.81: 「I understand how fired up you are. That's why we've kept up with you... but lately, you've been overdoing it. The rest of us can't keep up.」
lines.82: 「I just thought... if we could aim higher, work hard, and get a good result, wouldn't that be incredibly fun...?」
lines.83: 「Maybe that's how you feel, President, but if you think everyone else feels exactly the same way, you're making a huge mistake!」
lines.85: 「I admit it was my fault that my senpai felt I hadn't listened to them...」
lines.86: 「But I wanted you to understand how motivated I was.」
lines.87: 「We can't understand it exactly the way you want us to. We're not your parents.」
lines.90: 「And in the first placeee, President Konoe, you...!」
lines.91: That opened the floodgates, and complaints started pouring out from every member.
lines.92: 「And that summer training-camp plan, for one...!」
lines.93: Every opinion pointed to the same problem: Konoe kept running ahead of everyone.
lines.95: Konoe simply stood there and listened.
lines.96: ...She wasn't about to blow up even harder, was she?
lines.97: This was bad. If Konoe got any angrier, we'd have a real scene on our hands.
lines.98: 「H-hey... Maybe don't all pile on Konoe at once--」
lines.100: This time, Konoe covered my mouth.
lines.101: 「It's fine. As president, it's my duty to listen.」
lines.106: Was she planning to explode after she'd heard everything?
lines.107: 「According to my computer's analysis, most members see the club less as a place where tournament results come first and more as part of their school memories...」
lines.109: She seemed to take in every word thrown at her, one by one.
lines.110: Someone who was always blowing up was even scarier when she went quiet.
lines.111: I felt like I was standing on the shore right before a tsunami.
lines.113: 「...No one has anything else to say?」
lines.114: It seemed everyone had finally said their piece.
lines.117: Oh yeah. Here comes the shouting.
lines.118: 「...Thank you for sharing all your thoughts.」
lines.121: 「It's true. I was charging ahead. I didn't realize there was this much distance between me and everyone else.」
lines.122: 「The thing that hit hardest was hearing that just because I feel one way doesn't mean everyone else feels the same... You're absolutely right.」
lines.124: 「The previous president told me, 'I'm leaving this drama club to you.'」
lines.125: 「I got so fired up because I wanted to live up to those words.」
lines.126: 「But I spent so much time thinking about getting better results that I lost sight of what this club was supposed to be about.」
lines.127: 「I'm sorry for all the trouble I caused.」
lines.128: She gave them a formal bow.
lines.129: 「I'm going to take responsibility and resign as president.」
lines.130: Her calm response shocked everyone, me included.
lines.132: Her voice instantly switched to a roar.
lines.134: She was shouting at the three first-years who'd sabotaged the gate.
lines.136: 「No matter how much you dislike someone, sneaking around behind their back and taking pleasure in dirty tricks is unacceptable!」
lines.145: 「...Now. Changing presidents at this point would only create confusion, so I'll continue as president through the Sports and Martial Arts Festival.」
lines.146: 「After that, we'll all decide together what happens next. Let's hold a meeting after school sometime next week.」
lines.148: Everyone looked like they wanted to say something.
lines.149: 「Today's work is all done, so you're dismissed.」
lines.150: 「Thank you for coming in throughout the three-day break!」
lines.151: Konoe's energetic voice brought the meeting to a close.
lines.153: Then she walked out of the room without saying anything else.
lines.156: Or should I leave her alone?
lines.157: ...Damn it. I should at least see how she's doing.
lines.162: She thought she'd been taking the lead for everyone's sake, only to have all those complaints thrown at her.
lines.163: 「This is why I kept telling you not to let yourself get swept up in the moment...」
lines.164: She'd gone and gotten hurt by the exact same kind of thing all over again, without learning.
lines.165: What was I supposed to do with her?
lines.166: I thought about comforting her, then decided against it.
lines.167: She was probably crying somewhere... but from now on, she'd better learn from my whole theory about not getting carried away.
lines.168: 「Guess I'll head back to the executive committee.」
lines.169: They were probably still working too.
lines.171: I waited for a while, but no one came back.
lines.172: Their things were here... Maybe they were outside?
lines.173: 「Put that over here! Yes, right THERE!」
lines.174: 「And no whining over there! The girls are going to think you're pathetic!」
lines.175: Out on the field, the Princess was unusually leading from the front.
lines.176: Everyone was moving exactly as she told them to.
lines.177: 「...If you've got that much charisma, I guess letting yourself ride the momentum is a different story.」
lines.178: But Konoe and I were ordinary people.
lines.179: We had to learn how to handle things in moderation.
lines.180: I wasn't motivated enough to go help with manual labor.
lines.181: Maybe I'd go eat some ice cream at Matsukasa Park.
lines.182: With that thought, I headed for the school gate.
